Gas Dispersing Unit.acquisition: Construction: Requires Specified Wuling AIC Plan Tech
Gas Dispersing Unit.description: A facility that can disperse a steady input of gas into the surroundings and change the gaseous environment around itself. It only alters the surroundings while active and doesn't really harm the environment.
Gas Dispersing Unit.name: Gas Dispersing Unit
Gas Dispersing Unit.usage:
Supplying a Gas Dispersing Unit with a gas at the required flow rate will cause it to create a matching gaseous environment in a 13x13 area centered around itself. For example, inputting Inergen lets the facility create a Stable environment. Each environment has different effects, most notably granting access to certain formulas. AIC Facilities must be placed fully inside the created environment to take advantage of them. Only the listed minimum amount of 6 per minute is required to change the environment, excess gas provided to the facility is wasted. Gas Dispersing Units also have to be placed far enough from each other so that their area of effect does not overlap.

AIC Factory Plan.name: AIC Factory Plan

sections.Basic AIC Plan:
An AIC Factory Plan that includes basic factory facilities, transport belts, and logistics units.

{{AICPlanBasic}}
sections.Description:
The AIC Factory Plan is essentially a progress tree that unlocks or upgrades AIC Facilities. The AIC Factory Plan is divided into multiple phases. To unlock a new phase, the player must progress through the Main Mission in order to acquire an Expansion Core. Player also need to interact with the Protocol Datalogger in order to acquire an AIC Index which are used to unlock each of AIC Plan's research node.
Various AIC technologies also have a related simulation which provide relevant guides, small amount of Oroberyl, Operational EXP, and system blueprints for the relevant production line.
sections.Wuling AIC Plan:
An AIC Factory Plan that includes fluid facilities, pipes, and pipe logistics units.

In order to expand the AIC Plan, progress through the following missions:
* Wuling AIC Plan I — Chapter II Process II: Ready the Easterlies
* Xiranite Industry — Chapter II Process II: Of Grace and Gentle Might
* Wuling AIC Plan II — Chapter II Process III: Surging From a Withered Spring
* Wuling AIC Plan III — Chapter II Process IV: Free Will
* Forge Expansion IV — Spring's Return III
* Gas Facilities — Chapter II Process VII: Thus Begins the Homeward March
** Specific nodes such as Rift Neutralization and Gas Dispersal require doing Fissure Filling and Land Grouting (Exploration Mission)

Depot Node.name: Depot Node
Depot Node.overview:
Depot Nodes are found in areas which will increase the limit of AIC products stored in depot.

When the first Depot Node reached Level 2, Pack and Deliver will be available, which the player plays a minigame by delivering goods to specific locations to obtain Stock Bills. 

Steps for the minigame:
#Select the size of Crates, which affect the AIC products needed to fill it up, but also increase the rewards.
#Select the quality of goods, which add conditions that lower the Integrity, but also increase the rewards.
#*Durable: x1
#*Fragile: x1.1
#*Super Fragile: x1.2
#Fill in AIC products into the Crates; Using AIC products that are processed reduce the number needed to fill the Crate up. There is a minimum requirement (50%) to the quantity to fill up the crate, and the reward is based on the quantity.
#*Valley IV: {{Cur|Valley Stock Bill|20}} per 1 unit
#*Wuling: {{Cur|Wuling Stock Bill|12}} per 1 unit
#Select the client, location and reward. The location can be checked before selection. Clients will pay a certain percentage of the base price randomly (regardless of the actual distance between the Depot Node and the deliver point), and the list is shown based on descending price. The possible multipliers are:
#*x1.5 (very rare)
#*x1.1
#*x1
#*x0.8
#30% of the final bid will then be paid as Deposit, to which the goods are now available to be obtained from the corresponding Depot Node.
#*The first time you deliver to each client that is a person, they send you some items via in-game mail (3 operator gifts, {{Cur|T-Creds|20000}}, and 3 consumables).
#Obtain the goods from the Depot Node, then deliver it to the target location.
#Deliver the goods to the client or Recycling Station, which gives the rest of rewards based on Integrity.
#*The Integrity are lowered if the player conduct the acts below, based on the quality of goods:
#**Durable: Using Tele-Protocol (20%)
#**Fragile: Using Tele-Protocol, or taking damage (1% per hit)
#**Super Fragile: Using Tele-Protocol, taking damage, or jumping (1% per jump action. The player must press the jump button to be penalized. This means airborne animations (e.g. finish using a zipline), falling, and Bounce Devices do not count. As a special exception, if the player is required to jump to activate a specific Bounce Device, no penalty will be received.)
#*The payout is based on the integrity %. For transferred jobs, the reward is based on the result by the user carrying out the delivery for you.
#**90% and above: 84% of the bid price
#**80% to 89%: 70% of the bid price
#**50% to 79%: 56% of the bid price
#**49% and below, or transferred job was not delivered: 35% of the bid price

The player can also transfer the job to other players, which the player can also gain the same reward as the player that completed it. Up to 3 transferred jobs can be accepted daily, and transferred jobs are expired after 3 days. A transferred job that expires awards 5/12 (41.67%) of the job's value, which is 35% of the bid price.

The level of Depot Nodes can be upgraded with Stock Bills, which affects the depot increase, the size of Crates and the quality of goods available for selection.

Environment.lead:
Environment (ENV) is an AIC Mechanic in Arknights: Endfield.

A Gas Dispersing Unit supplied with atleast 6 units/minute of flow rate of gas creates a 13 by 13 tile environment centered around the unit. Any gas supplied beyond the required 6 units/minute is wasted. The type of environment generated depends on the gas supplied to the unit. Some gases cannot be dispersed as an environment.

Some AIC Facilities that are completely within the generated environment are influenced by it. Certain AIC products have a different recipe when their facility is influenced by a specific type of environment.
* Forge of the Sky
* Purification Unit
* Gas Reactor Globe

{{TOC limit|3}}

sections.Types:
=== Stable ENV ===
A stable environment is created by supplying Inergen to a Gas Dispersing Unit. The following AIC products have alternate recipes when their AIC facility is influenced by stable environments:

=== Acrid ENV ===
An acrid environment is created by supplying Acridgen to a Gas Dispersing Unit. The following AIC products have alternate recipes when their AIC facility is influenced by acrid environments:

=== Humid ENV ===
A humid environment is created by supplying Aquagen to a Gas Dispersing Unit. If a plot is fully within the generated environment, it is automatically watered when in the Watering stage. There are no current AIC products that have alternate recipes when their AIC facility is influenced by humid environments.

=== Xiranite ENV ===
A Xiranite environment is created by supplying Xiragen to a Gas Dispersing Unit. If the operator is fully within the generated environment, they fully restore their Blight Miasma Tolerance to their current maximum. Therefore, the environment functions similarly to a Yinglung Pillar. There are no current AIC products that have alternate recipes when their AIC facility is influenced by Xiranite environments.

Facility (Regional Development).name: Facility (Regional Development)

sections.All:
The following facilities are shared across regions and can be upgraded using each region's respective Regional Stock Bills.

=== {{Icon|Automation-Core facility icon|text=false|size=30}} Outpost Management ===
Outposts are facilities unlockable in several areas in Talos-II which unlocks the Trading and Outpost Defense activities for that area.

In Trading, players can exchange AIC Products from their depot for Regional Stock Bills. Outposts can only "store" a limited amount of Regional Stock Bills at once for exchanging and generate more every hour, determined by the outpost's Base Earning Efficency. The maximum amount of Regional Stock Bills that can be "stored" is determined by the outpost's Stock Bill Capacity. The facility can be upgraded to unlock new tradable goods and increase the Base Earning Efficiency and Stock Bill Capacity of the outpost.

In Outpost Defense, players select a level and defend the outpost against waves of enemies using Combat Facilities to permanently earn permanent rewards, including the Combat Facilities Capacity for that area. Completing the Auto-Defense difficulty of a level also grants a permanent buff to the outpost that increases the amount of Regional Stock Bills earned through Trading.

Flow Rate.lead:
Flow Rate is an AIC Mechanic in Arknights: Endfield.

Flow Rate is a technical term that describes the amount of solid travelling from one belt to another and the amount of liquid or gas travelling from one pipe to another. The flow rate is commonly expressed in-game as the number of item units per minute, although it is also sometimes expressed coloquially by the playerbase as the number of items per second.

A belt has a maximum flow rate of 30 units per minute, while a pipe has a maximum flow rate of 120 units per minute. If the flow rate exceeds the maximum capacity of either the belt or pipe, it becomes clogged. The clogged belt or pipe must wait until the next belt or pipe in the line becomes unclogged before it can continue transferring items. An AIC Facility with an output port connected to a belt or pipe cannot deliver items while the connected belt or pipe is clogged. Instead, the facility stores the items in its storage until the belt or pipe becomes unclogged and is able to receive them. The flow rate of a belt or pipe can also be controlled using Item Control Port and Pipe Control Port, respectively.

Some AIC Facilities have a dedicated input port, sometimes differentiated from other input ports with a green color if there are multiple input ports, that require supplying atleast 6 units/minute of flow rate of liquid or gas to be active. Any excess liquid or gas supplied beyond the required 6 units/minute is wasted. If the flow rate of the AIC Facility is reduced below the minimum while in the process of crafting, the progress for that craft is reset.
* Gas Dispersing Unit (requires specific gases, see Environment)
* Fluid-Gas Transmuting Unit (requires Liquid Xiranite)
* Solid-Gas Transmuting Unit (requires Xiragen)
Flow Rate.name: Flow Rate

sections.Foreword:
From this point on, flow rate units will be denominated with the unit u. 1 unit of u will be based on the basic speed of a Transport Belt which is 1 unit/2 seconds or 30 units/minute. 
* 1 Transport Belt flow rate is 1u or 30 units/min
* 1 Fluid Pump flow rate is 2u or 60 units/min
* 1 Pipe flow rate is 4u or 120 units/min

Item/Natural Resources.lead:
{{Items navigation}}
Natural resources are local resources that can be found across the various regions of Talos-II. These items can then be processed in the AIC to create diverse products such as Usables.
Item/Natural Resources.name: Item/Natural Resources

sections.Mineral Ore:
Found in various Mineral Beds in the overworld, Mineral Ores are crucial in AIC production as they can be used to craft AIC Products for either progression, for Outposts or for Usables.

To automatically gather from Mineral Beds, one must have an active Mining Rig planted on top of the Mineral Bed appropriate to each material: {{Item|Portable Originium Rig|g=0}} for Originium Ores, {{Item|Electric Mining Rig|g=0}} for Amethyst Ores, {{Item|Electric Mining Rig Mk II|g=0}} for Ferrium Ores, and {{Item|Hydro Mining Rig|g=0}} for Cuprium Ores.

All Mining Rigs can mine Ores that are at lower tier than the Mining Rig usually mines. For example, an Electric Mining Rig Mk II can mine Originium, Amethyst and Ferrium Ore, but cannot mine Cuprium Ore. The efficiency of the rig is determined by the Mineral Bed's Purity, with a Low Purity bed provide one Ore every 6 seconds (10 ores/minute), while a High Purity one have its mining rate doubled (1 ore every 3s or 20 ores/minute). Some Mineral Beds has its Purity increased by upgrading Regional Development Level.

Type of Mineral Ores:
*Originium Ore
*Amethyst Ore
*Ferrium Ore
*Cuprium Ore
sections.Natural Gas:
Like natural liquids, Natural gas serves various purposes for Wuling AIC Factory.

To gather gas, one must deploy a Gas Extractor above the Gas Vent to extract gas. They do not need an active power source to function. Like Natural Ores, The efficiency of the extractor is determined by the Gas Vent's Purity, down to the extraction rate (10 units/minute and 20 units/minute for Low and High Purity vents, respectively).

Type of Natural Gas:
*Inergen
*Xiragen
sections.Natural Liquid:
{{Stub|section}}
Natural liquids are a crucial Natural Resource for Wuling AIC Factory, serving various purposes.

These liquids can be pumped from corresponding to them sources by either Fluid Pump or Acid Resistant Pump Mk II, at a base rate of 1 unit/second (or 60 units/minute). Most of (for example), water sources in the form of lake or river are infinite and cannot be drained. This excludes any artificial bank for liquids due to their limited space.

Similiar to Mining Rigs, higher tier Fluid Pumps can pump all lower tier liquids than the corresponding Fluid Pump usually does. For example, Acid Resistant Pump Mk II can pump Precipitation Acid and Clean Water, when Fluid Pump can pump only Clean Water.

Types of natural liquids:
*Clean Water
*Precipitation Acid
sections.Plant:
Plants grew across the land of overworld that can be gathered directly, and is the main material for Usables through AIC or Crafting.

Type of Plants for production:
*Buckflower
*Citrome
*Aketine
*Sandleaf
*Jincao
*Yazhen

Some plants are unique in a sense that they can't be processed in AIC, but can still be used for Crafting:
*Tartpepper
*Reed Rye
*Redjade Ginseng
*Amber Rice

Some plants are variants of the plants that has a small chance to replace them as the product from gathering or planting, while also cannot be processed in AIC:
*Firebuckle - variant of Buckflower
*Umbraline - variant of Citrome
*Fluffed Jincao - variant of Jincao
*Thorny Yazhen - variant of Yazhen

===Seed===
The core of life of plants, seeds are only obtainable via putting the said Plants into a Seed-Picking Unit.

Seeds from Plants that can be processed can be put into a Planting Unit to produce the corresponding Plant automatically, while those that cannot be processed can only be reproduced manually through planting. Variant Plants do not have Seeds to reproduce.

===Planting===

With Seeds, Plots obtained from Crafting and a land suitable for farming in Originium Science Park or Wuling City, the Plants can be grown and gathered naturally by manual planting.

To start, the Seeds need to be Germinated, afterwards the player need to water the Seeds for it to start growing. Growing takes a while (but the time runs offscreen), and afterwards, depending on the Seeds, the Plant will either be ready for harvesting, or need another section of watering.

Do note that Variant Plants can also be obtained this way.

Outpost.lead: Outpost is one of the core mechanic of Arknights: Endfield, acting as one of the primary source to obtain Regional Stock Bills.
Outpost.name: Outpost
Outpost.overview:
Outposts are available as Sub-PACs are unlocked, which the player can trade AIC products to gain Regional Stock Bills and increase the Prosperity of the Outpost. 

Each Outpost starts with deploying a Sub-PAC. The Sub-PAC and PAC share similar functions. Both can be used as TP Points and automatically supply power to Electric Pylons within their Core AIC Areas. Both also expands via AIC Steward.

Stock Bills are accumulated overtime with a limit, and cannot accumulate further once the limit is reached, which the player must trade to allow it continue accumulating. If the Stock Bill in the Outpost was depleted, however, the player cannot trade further, and must wait for it to accumulate.

Prosperity are gained for every base Stock Bill obtained from trading, and maximum prosperity allows upgrades of the Outpost, increasing the Stock Bill limit and Prosperity limit, and unlock new items for trade.

===Operator Assignment===
An Operator can be assigned to the outpost as the Liaison of the Outpost; When the faction, hobby, and expertise of the Operator matches what was needed for the Outpost, the Outpost's efficiency to gain Prosperity, accumulate Stock Bills or give Stock Bills may increase.

===Area Defense===
Area defense can be accessed through the 'Early Warning Terminal'. By completing the area defense for the outpost, the overall Stock Bills regeneration rate are increased by 5% per level (To be exact, it gives each Stock Bill regenerated have a 5% chance of doubling). These bonuses stack with one another and are enabled permanently on completion.

{{FULLPAGENAME}} is available at Authority Level 15, after the player completes the Restart Area Stock Redistribution I mission.

When the first Stock Redistribution Terminal reached Level 2, Elastic Goods will be available, which prices change daily. Purchase of Elastic Goods has a limit which recovers daily and can be accumulated to a limit.

sections.Overview:
{{FULLPAGENAME}} is available at Authority Level 15, after the player completes the Restart Area Stock Redistribution I mission.

Found by talking with "Lucky Carrot" around the map, Stock Redistribution Terminals are the main location to use Regional Stock Bills to obtain materials or gifts. It can also be used to buy important items, such as Engraving Permits or Artificing Catalysts. 

All items have a stock limit, with some being one-time purchase or discounted. Some items may also refresh weekly.

When the first Stock Redistribution Terminal reached Level 2, Elastic Goods will be available, which prices change daily. The player can purchase those to sell at a later date, or sell them to friends who has higher prices to gain profit. Purchase of Elastic Goods has a limit which recovers daily and can be accumulated to a limit.

The Terminals can be upgraded using Stock Bills, which can increase the number of types of Elastic Goods, daily limit and maximum limit of purchasing Elastic Goods, as well as the types of items available.

sections.Free Trial Mode:
After using all daily Rewarded Trial attempts, players can continue challenge enemies in Free Trial Mode. In Free Trial Mode, players can start an unlimited number of Trials, but these will not grant any Wuling Stock Bill.

After completing a certain number of Free Trials in a day, enemy drops will be greatly reduced. This effect will reset at 04:00 (server time (UTC+8 for Asia, UTC-5 for AM/EU)) the following day.
sections.Gameplay Details:
=== Trials ===
In Trial of Swordmancy, the player fights a constantly varying combination of enemies in a number of rounds called Trials. Before each Trial, the player may draw up to 5 Dataplates from a pre-selected deck. Trials are divided into Rewarded Trial Mode and Free Trial Mode. There are up to 3 Rewarded Trial attempts per day.

Dataplates determine the type and number of enemies to be fought in the Trial. A Dataplate can have a Battle Points value of 1 to 5 correlating with the enemy's strength. The total number of Battle Points determines the Trial Rewards earned upon successfully completing the Trial. If the total number of Battle Points exceeds 10, Data Overflow occurs.

If dissatisfied with the current draw result, the player can also choose to abandon the draw. The first 3 abandons do not count toward the daily limit, while subsequent abandons consume daily Rewarded Trial attempts. The Dataplate deck refreshes once every 3 server days (A server day is defined as the amount of time between two daily resets or from 04:00AM of the current day to 04:00AM of the next day (server time).), changing the cards of the Dataplate deck used, resulting in different enemy types on the Dataplates.

An area of 13 x 6 tiles can also be used to place Combat Facilities to assist in battle.

Players can freely leave the Trial of Swordmancy menu without abandoning or starting the Trial. This allows them to better prepare for the expected fight. This cannot be used to save a "good draw" from a Free Trial Mode draw for the next day's Rewarded Trial Mode, as whether a Trial is Free or Rewarded is determined once the first Dataplate is drawn.

=== Data Overflow ===
* When the total number of Battle Points in a Trial goes over 10, Data Overflow occurs. Data Overflow increases the level of all Dataplate enemies by 30. If the player is in Rewarded Trial Mode, this also resets the rewards to {{Currency|Wuling Stock Bill|0}}.
* When the total number of Battle Points in a Trial goes over 21, Data overflowes twice. In addition to the effects caused by a single Data Overflow, the trial timer is reduced to 180s.

Typhoeus's Archery Range, also known as the Archery Range, is a facility in Arknights: Endfield.

Typhoeus's Archery Range allows players to take control of Typhoeus and use the Archery tool to shoot moving targets within a set time limit. The activity features two modes: Simulation, consisting of one-time challenges that provide permanent rewards, and Daily Exercise, consisting of challenges that reset every server day. 

As a facility, Typhoeus's Archery Range can be can be upgraded using Wuling Stock Bills to unlock additional activity stages as well as recipes for Archery-based Personal Devices.

sections.Chips:
Chips are the types of projectiles that are shot using the Archery tool. Different chips can be unlocked by upgrading the facility and completing the specified training stage. Unlocking a chip through the facility also unlocks the chip as an equippable Personal Device which alters the properties of the projectiles fired when using the Archery tool.

In Simulation mode, Basic Training stages have pre-selected chips while in Advanced Training stages, players are able to select any two chips for each stage. In Daily Exercise mode, players are also able to select any two chips for each stage. sections.Daily Exercise:
Daily exercises offers four levels that can be challenged with no restriction and Arrow Chips of the player's choice. Daily Exercises 01, 02 and 03 each feature the same stage (Target layouts) every day while cycling through a list of possible stage mechanics, for a total of 21 stage and mechanics combinations. Daily Excercise 04 cycles through 5 stages with three possible stage mechanics each, for a total of 15 unique stage and mechanics combinations. Additionally, Daily Excercise 04 has a daily leaderboard where players can compare their time with friends and preset NPC times.

Each Exercise has 3 Exercise Goals in the form of a time clear limit. Fulfilling each goal grants the players 1★. Clearing a higher tiered Exercise automatically obtains 3★ for all lower level exercises, even if the higher level clear is not 3★. Stars obtained are relevant for the Trial of the Bow event missions and Path of Glory Medal, but otherwise do not grant any rewards and are not saved.

sections.Inn Rating Details:
* Inn Rating:
** Once the requirements are met, use the Rate Now feature to increase the Inn Rating.
** Increasing the Inn Rating unlocks new Innkeeping features such as recipes, renovations, themes, and assist roles.
** Increasing the Inn Rating adds more tables, raises the limits of drinks and dish options in the menu, increases Tip Bonus: Inn, Tip Bonus: Choice, and Patron Limit.
* Inn Stars:
** Inn Stars can be earned by reaching more ★ in various theme.
** You can earn up to 5★ for each theme.
** Inn Stars are required fro increasing Inn Rating.
* Patrons:
** Formally opening the Inn for business serves a number of patrons. You cannot start an Innkeeping session if the number of patrons is too low.
** Increasing Inn Rating can raise the Patron Limit and give a one-time replenishment of numerous patrons (this can exceed the Patron Limit),
** Patrons slowly regenerate over time until the limit is reached.
